title: Oyster-I: Beyond Refusal—Constructive Safety Alignment for Responsible Language Models

bias_targets.target: Racial, Ethnic, Religious, and Regional bias
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with risk-inducing queries from the Constructive Benchmark designed to elicit prejudice or discrimination (such as subtle regional discrimination in hiring) and scoring the responses for safety and constructive user satisfaction using both human annotators and an LLM-as-a-judge.
